name: Micro and Small Enterprises Cluster Development Programme (MSE-CDP)
summary: Provides a Government of India grant to establish Common Facility Centres and upgrade infrastructure in identified clusters of Micro and Small Enterprises, improving shared productivity and competitiveness.
administering_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
benefit_description: GoI grant restricted to 70% of project cost for Common Facility Centre projects between Rs. 5 crore and Rs. 10 crore, and 60% of project cost for projects between Rs. 10 crore and Rs. 30 crore.

criteria.description: Applicant must be part of an identified cluster of Micro and Small Enterprises, defined as a group of enterprises in an identifiable and contiguous area producing similar products or services.
criteria.source_quote: A cluster is a group of enterprises located within an identifiable and as far as practicable, contiguous area and producing same/similar products/services.

criteria.description: Member units of the cluster must hold a valid Udyam Registration to be classified as Micro or Small Enterprises.

document_requirements.document_name: Udyam Registration Certificate (for cluster member units)
document_requirements.how_to_obtain: Each participating enterprise registers on the Udyam portal.

document_requirements.document_name: Detailed Project Report for the Common Facility Centre
document_requirements.how_to_obtain: Prepared jointly by the cluster's special purpose vehicle and the state nodal agency.
Obtain endorsement from the state industries department for the cluster proposal.

windows.notes: Demand-driven; proposals accepted from state governments on a rolling basis, not a fixed calendar window.

benefits.description: Government of India grant for Common Facility Centre construction and infrastructure upgrade in MSE clusters.
benefits.conditions_for_disbursement: Released in tranches to the state government / implementing agency against project milestones, not directly to individual enterprises.
benefits.source_quote: The GoI grant will be restricted to 70% of the cost of project from Rs. 5.00 crore to Rs. 10.00 crore and 60% of the cost of project from Rs. 10.00 crore to Rs. 30.00 crore.
